decision.observation: 6 mph, gear 1, timer 36:13.414, red X lit. The W+A conversion pulled the car off the gravel to the LEFT onto grass; the road now lies up-frame and to the right of the nose, curving right past white marker posts, with a boulder and small tree to the left.
decision.hypothesis: Steering during the conversion did not help — it pushed the car the wrong way off the road. With the road on the car's right and the known natural rightward drift, plain W should carry it back onto the gravel without another steer input that could stall it.
decision.memory: W+A at the R->1 conversion is now a failed variant (left the road). Revert to plain W; the rightward drift is useful when the road lies to the right.
